recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the already-approved FHIR-43208 clarification without changing broader search prefix semantics or taking ownership of separate search-prefix cleanup issues.
issue_request: FHIR-43208 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested clearer Search prefix range examples for less precise dates, and the approved disposition was to split quantity and time examples so range-below and range-above behavior for dates would not be confused with numeric ranges.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by commit a88a8175b5cf23acf8cf55bf44fbfc4834d90833, which split decimal and date/time examples in source/search.html. That application left two copied/stale month examples: 2015-08 started at 2015-08-12 and range-before 2015-08 used invalid boundary 2015-08-00.
additional_context: source/search.html is the FHIR-core Search page associated with the Jira related page. Nearby current date search notes define year-month dates as intervals beginning at the first instant of the first day of the month and ending at the last instant of the last day, supporting 2015-08-01 as the lower boundary and 2015-09-01 as the upper exclusive boundary. FHIR-I Confluence minutes from 2024-04-22 confirm the 8-0-0 motion and split-example disposition; no Zulip discussion or separate Jira issue was found for the invalid 2015-08-00 text.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html so the date 2015-08 range starts at 2015-08-01T00:00:00.0000 and the range-before 2015-08 example ends at 2015-08-01T00:00:00.000000000000000.
source_changes: source/search.html: corrected the less precise date range-of-value example for 2015-08 to start on 2015-08-01 instead of 2015-08-12.
source/search.html: corrected the range-below example for 2015-08 to use 2015-08-01 instead of invalid date 2015-08-00.
